environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has three listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: AWS WAFv2 WebACL association with rule group 'internal-uri-encoding-normalization' that applies double-URL-decode and HTML entity decode transformations before inspection, (2) Priority 10: a custom rule with ByteMatchStatement inspecting query string values after UrlDecode+Lowercase transformations for the patterns: UNION, SELECT, FROM, WHERE, OR '1', with action BLOCK, (3) The target group has a Lambda@Edge origin-request function that strips any query parameter value exceeding 64 bytes. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM policy with an explicit Deny on s3:* and ssm:GetParameter to prevent data exfiltration even if UNION-based extraction succeeds partially.

config.query_param_length_limit: 64 bytes per value enforced at edge
